[b]The Emergency Elections of 2026 resulted in a decisive change of Sikirsks entire political system.
For the first time in the Federations modern history; a single party, the Sikirskian Pan-Shamatist Salvation Party (SP-SSP), has secured full legislative control without coalition partners.[/b]

SP-SSP (66%) - ruling majority, Pan-Shamatist nationalist bloc under Volodymyr Uladzimir
CTO (17%) - central-conservative opposition, Mitarskis former government party
RCS (9%) - moderate social-republican reformists
NPA (5%) - liberal-progressive urban movement
RAU (3%) - agrarian populist regional party

[b]Prime Minister Vadrov:[/b] [i]With all the current tensions in the world, it is good to see a levelheaded man and his party being elected to power. A Sikirsk-First policy will be good for the Pan-Shamatist Federatsiya of Sikirsk as well as the whole continent.[/i]

The Ledger also reports that it is no secret that Valodya's government was rooting for a more right-wing party to win the elections. Nationalism is seen as a great asset in Valodyan culture and politics.

It is no secret that Valodya has been eyeing membership in the Echelon Collective for a while now, maybe this election result will finally give them the push they need to officially apply.
[/spoiler]
